title: Squad Leader - Swedish Armed Forces
description: {"text": "Served during the conscript year and first months as a professional soldier as deputy combat squad leader. Was later promoted to squad leader position on operational readiness units. UN MINUSMA deployment in Mali in 2022. Served the final year in a close protection unit."}
